Thank you for installing {{ .Chart.Name }}.

Your release is named {{ .Release.Name }}.

The controller and CRDs have been installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

To verify the installation:

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl get customresourcedefinitions

To learn more about the release, try:

  $ helm status {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  $ helm get all {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
{{- if .Values.dashboard.enabled }}
{{- if eq (default "memory" .Values.dashboard.sessionStore.type) "memory" }}

WARNING: dashboard sessions use in-memory storage. Every rollout invalidates
all sessions and multiple replicas do not share them. Set
dashboard.sessionStore.type=redis for production or HA.
{{- end }}
{{- if .Values.dashboard.bootstrap.enabled }}

The dashboard is available at {{ .Values.dashboard.publicURL }} and starts with
local administrator authentication only (no OIDC provider is required).

Read the generated administrator password with:

  kubectl get secret {{ include "idp.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "dashboard-local-admin" "context" .) }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath='{.data.initial-password}' | base64 -d

Sign in as user "admin" with that password. The Secret is created once and is
never overwritten on upgrade.
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
